content.text: Submitted. The proposal now makes a single in-sentence replacement in Section 13.5 — removing the "reasonable approximation … deemed to be liquidated damages and not a penalty" deeming language and confirming that no liquidated damages or penalties are payable by Customer — while leaving the first-sentence recital and all other text byte-for-byte unchanged. The official minimality gate passes, and both preferred elements are covered by that one operation.
